slide_title: Vector Notation for Linear Regression and Classification (One Sample)

bullets: y = w1 x1 + w2 x2 + w2 x2 + ... + wn xn + b
Input:  X = (column vector x1, x2, x3, ..., xd)
W = (column vector W1, W2, W3, ..., Wd)
y = ( w1  w2  ...  wn ) (column vector x1, x2, ..., xn) + b
y = ( b  w1  w2  ...  wd ) (column vector 1, x1, x2, ..., xd)
"b" may be added at begin of the vector or at end of the vector
Same for "1" added to input vector

layout.arrangement: Title centered at top in blue with red underline; slide number '16' in a yellow circle at top-right. Below title: left column contains two stacked pale-yellow 'Model' boxes (top: I/P and O/P vectors; below: the linear equation y = w1x1+...+b) followed by a small boxed 'y = W^T X + b'. Right of these, upper-right, a large white box showing Input X column vector, W column vector, and Output (y). Middle band: a pale-yellow box (left) showing y = row vector (w1...wn) times column vector (x1...xn) + b, an arrow pointing right to a pale-green box showing y = row vector (b w1...wd) times augmented column vector (1, x1...xd), then another arrow to a boxed 'y = W^T X'. Bottom-left: a peach 'Note' box. Bottom-center: a pale-green box with 'y = W^T X / Where X is Augmented vector / W is d+1 dimension'. Bottom-right: pale-yellow box 'Model Parameter is W'. Whole slide framed by a thin dark-red border.
